subject: Cladonia matches 161510 (MKSRV -> 8LPWL) and 612934 (VKSW6 -> MKX9Q): authorship disagreement between the -04 workbook and the -08 decision report
finding: The -04 workbook was right; the -08 decision report was wrong. Its decision-list wording ('same name, rank, authorship and family') described all seven consequential matches, but the receipt classifies five of them, including both Cladonia, as evidence 'same_name_record_authorship_differs'. That means a shared non-nomenclatural record (iNaturalist/Wikidata) and differing authorship. Only Colpoma juniperi and Lecanora argentata are exact.

161510.r1_col: MKSRV accepted 'Cladonia rigida var. rigida' authorship '(J.D. Hook. & Taylor) Hampe' (COL 26.7 XR, source 2030 Artsnavnebasen)
161510.current_col: 8LPWL accepted 'Cladonia rigida var. rigida' authorship '' (COL 26.9 XR, source 2030)
161510.said_differs: R2-decisions-r04.xlsx 'Same-name successors' and build-r2c review-data holds110 ('authorship missing on one side')

612934.r1_col: VKSW6 accepted 'Cladonia verticillaris' authorship '(Raddi) Mont.' (COL 26.7 XR, source 2030 Artsnavnebasen)
612934.current_col: MKX9Q accepted 'Cladonia verticillaris' authorship '(Raddi) Fr.' (COL 26.9 XR, source 2031 BrazilianFlora)
612934.said_differs: R2-decisions-r04.xlsx 'Same-name successors' ('Hold: authorship or family differs')

outcome: Not resolved cleanly: the combination authors differ (Mont. vs Fr.) or one is missing, and no nomenclatural record links the usages. Following the owner's condition, both stay held; the other five continuities were applied.
related: Xylaria tabacina 607370 (TPKPX -> VRRW2, approved by the owner and applied) has the same kind of difference: (J. Kickx f.) Fr., 1851 vs (J. Kickx f.) Berk., linked by iNat 1066592 and Wikidata Q108482457 only. Flagged for the owner.
